add.title: How I write to this screen
add.text:
**Tool:** `page_add` / `page_set` on path `/live/`. I pass only the card fields; the tool stamps `id`, `by: voice-app`, `ts` and appends one line to `public/live/page.jsonl`.

**The line it wrote for this card:**
```json
{"content":{"add":{"id":"how-live-writes","type":"part-card","title":"How I write to this screen","text":"…"}},"by":"voice-app","ts":"…"}
```

**page.js** holds no data, three lines: `new Live({ meta, title: "Live", classes: "hides-nav" })`.

**Live.js** replays the jsonl: `clear` empties the Map, `add` sets by id, `remove` deletes, a line keyed by an existing id merges `title`/`text` in place. `draw()` renders each Map item as a row.

**Edit in place** (what I'll use for progress updates, one line each):
```json
{"how-live-writes":{"text":"new text"},"by":"voice-app","ts":"…"}
```

**Not yet:** feed order newest-first, preview/full view per card, subpages. Those are the next experiment.

Design the UX first, then build.

What exists: framework/ui (widgets), ext/Mention (icon + name + link), Page.preview_card, templates (core/Page/Template). None of it is reachable from a feed line yet. A card line today:

```json
{"id": "ui-design", "type": "part-card", "preview": "UI design", "title": "UI design", "text": "..."}
```

Proposed: a card whose header is a real thing, via mention, and which can carry a theme:

```json
{"id": "page-ctx", "type": "part-context", "of": "#Page", "classes": "dark", "content": ["page-tools", "ui-design"]}
```

`of` resolves through ext/Mention to icon, name, url. `content` lists child card ids, so the context card groups them.

```js
class ContextCard extends LiveCard {
	header(){ return mention(this.of); }   // icon + name, links through
}
```

add.title: Where we are: the card system
add.text:
**Built, working now**
- Feed on /live: add, remove, edit by id; preview and full view; title first, edit later.
- Text is one markdown blob. `#Page` and `@owner` render as icon + link via ext/Mention.
- One custom renderer (Today) registered in code, by `live` name.

**Not built**
- A card body as a list of items with ids, so an edit touches one paragraph, not the blob.
- A registry: every UI piece (framework/ui widgets, ext/*, Page subclasses) addressable by a `type` from a jsonl line.
- Context cards (header = a real thing, children grouped).
- Server-side page instances (requirements doc only).
- Tool collapse (plan only; direction: Item.set is the universal call).

**Plan, in order**
1. Registry: `type` on a line picks a class. Start with three: text, code, mention.
2. Body as `content` list of typed items, each with an id. Edits are then `{"<card>": {"<item>": {"text": "..."}}}`.
3. Context card = a card whose header is a mention and whose content is other cards.

Surgical word-level edits stay a rewrite of one small item; that is fine once items are small.

add.title: What is a LiveCard? The four classes behind /live
add.text:
All in [/live/Live.js](/framework/files/?path=live/Live.js), 150 lines.

**Live** extends #Page. The page itself. Owns the log and draws the feed, newest first.

**LiveLog** extends JSONL. Replays page.jsonl: `clear` empties, `add` inserts by id, `remove` deletes, a bare id merges fields. This is the delta engine for this page.

**Tail**. Polls page.jsonl every ~3 s with a byte Range; only new bytes are replayed. The thing a socket would replace.

**LiveCard** extends #Page. One feed row as a small page. `preview()` draws the stock preview card you see in the feed; `full()` draws back-link, title, markdown body. A custom renderer (only Today so far) is picked by a `live` name.

So: a card is a Page, which is why I keep saying the registry should be Page subclasses picked by `type`.

Also found: `framework/library/` (Library, Collection, Entry, Item, Rail, Stage) is new and unexplored; it may overlap.
